title: The agent-spawn guard counts a marker on any line of a brief, so a pasted template block falsely refuses a haiku reviewer
why: A lane pasting the template's "Agent spawn brief head" block whole gets a haiku reviewer refused for a marker it did not mean.
source: Coordinator 17:04 CST Nov 13, from lane brief-from-step (session_013NEJL3zemFrPdTzdnwhpVi; PRs #3261, #3262); the lane's measures, unchecked by the coordinator and by triage.
note: Filed 17:05 CST Nov 13. Lane measured it (PR #3261 final reviewer). Decide: the guard reads line 1 only, or it skips fenced blocks. A lane reads the guard first. A guard verdict changes, so `Guard or check: yes`. Same family as step reviewer-round-1-model-vs-marker. The lane fences the template block itself in #3261 (first line only, ruling own-r3-reviewer-sonnet-high). NOTE, not a step: marker `Docs only: yes` has no reader. Debt note spawn-guard-marker-any-line exists in the repo. Past rulings not checked. Not started. Coordinator 19:54 CST Nov 13 (19:53, owner asked it to start the lanes): lane started, session_013NEJL2PQvDorgDZsKeSyfn (Sonnet, medium; searches for duplicates first). Triage 20:37 CST Nov 13: builder half struck (rewritten in place: title and why). Lane spawn-marker-skip-fences (PR #3324) found no guard that reads a builder's round marker: guard.py step_up_reason and the model row read role == "reviewer" only; decision agent-model-cap has no builder round row; the test-author reproduced only the false refusal of a haiku reviewer.
